# Claws: the cluster mark, four gold claws at a gem's corners. Origin at the gem's base centre.
# Generated by make_env.py. Up Z, front -Y.
new
material new Claw --base-color 0.9608 0.8471 0.5765 --no-slot
add mesh cone --name C0 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.08 --radius2 0 --depth 0.15 --location -0.190 -0.190 0.075 --rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
material assign Claw
add mesh cone --name C1 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.08 --radius2 0 --depth 0.15 --location 0.190 -0.190 0.075 --rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
material assign Claw
add mesh cone --name C2 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.08 --radius2 0 --depth 0.15 --location -0.190 0.190 0.075 --rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
material assign Claw
add mesh cone --name C3 --vertices 4 --radius1 0.08 --radius2 0 --depth 0.15 --location 0.190 0.190 0.075 --rotation 0 0 45
apply --rotation
material assign Claw
select C0 C1 C2 C3
active C0
join
rename C0 Claws
shade flat
export claws.glb
